title: Tipt mountain trials / Kyv Heartstriker Jhiru
summary: Advance through cragbeasts, repeating ghosts and a riddle before facing Jhiru.
overview: Advance through cragbeasts, repeating ghosts and a riddle before facing Jhiru.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Clear each triggered group fully, solve the current riddle rather than guessing, and prepare a backup tank for Jhiru's hate changes.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Approaching the cragbeast trigger releases six hatchlings; killing them summons their mother.
The ghost area releases eight spirits, each of which creates a replacement on death. Defeat the complete spirit sequence to open the key room.
With the required key available, request Rikabi's riddle and turn in one matching answer object. Incorrect or multiple answer items have consequences.
Keep Jhiru in his arena: leaving its boundary raises his melee damage. He lowers the hate of a top target using certain defensive disciplines.
Jhiru's death locks the expedition and summons Master Stonespiritist Okkanu.

notes: Approval E376. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
